status: Post-hoc descriptive robustness analysis of already inspected input-stage results; not a preregistered hypothesis test

metrics.whole_log: Existing signed mean reference-token log probability difference, full minus singleton-zeroed, excluding EOS.
metrics.first_log: Signed first fixed reference-token log probability difference, full minus singleton-zeroed.
metrics.first_probability: Signed first fixed reference-token probability difference, exp(full first log p) minus exp(zeroed first log p). Same intervention as before; not Information Horizon.

checks: Verify source ZIP CRC and fixed SHA256, original source/lock/manifest evidence, encoded images and feature-file byte hashes without loading tensor contents.

Verify question/feature/seed/target identities, prompt and target-position mappings, fresh reference scoring/alignment, complete unique 576-position grids, per-token log probability sums/means, all stored sensitivity arithmetic and full-forward controls.
Compare per-question E-I ranks on all positions, 566 non-basis positions, and photo-only non-basis positions. FPS basis and padding are labeled, not silently discarded from canonical results.
Retain the prior tie-aware non-basis error thirds, summarize individual effects within groups, and compare high-minus-low mean effects; these are not joint interventions.
Compare GQA same-image pairs under each score with identical feature/native hashes. Record target length, subword pieces and baseline confidence as interpretation limits.
Check one-token score identity and within-question rank invariance of first-log versus first-probability; report any undefined correlations or extra probability ties.

Retain all 12 MMStar cases. Add labeled sensitivity summaries without five newly flagged grounding cases, two prior question-quality cases, and their union. These post-hoc subsets are not a new accepted cohort or a clean/validated denominator.

Use only the archived six-question validity panel to describe feature-norm and perturbation-strength associations, with its 16 random, 8 high-I and 8 low-E-high-I positions separated. Do not generalize targeted-stratum associations or infer causation from magnitude correlations.
aggregation: Summarize per question within each dataset, and report image counts; no pooled-token p-values or causal task/dataset/layer claims. GQA questions share six images. Canonical counts remain 30 questions / 24 images / 17,280 singleton interventions; validity repeats are not new canonical samples.
scope: No new inference, metric replacement, original report rewriting, cohort changes, native-source edits, dependency changes or claim to reproduce IH. IH is optional. The existing zero-only layer calibration remains exploratory; full sweep stays disabled pending review.
